messages:
autoscale-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: GPU pool saturation for cluster-prod. Queue 'inference-requests' > 2000 and growing. P1. On-call: @sam. Please acknowledge and follow runbook: /runbooks/gpu-saturation

sam: ack - I'm on it. pulling metrics and kubectl now.

sam: quick snapshot: queue length 2124, avg wait ~11.8s. pods Pending=34 because NodePool 'gpupool-prod' at maxNodes=40. CA reports scale blocked by max node limit.

priya: pinging infra. Do we have a hard cloud quota preventing more GPUs? I see project quota shows GPUs allowed=42 total, but nodepool maxNodes=40. If nodes spin up we might hit quota at 42.

diego: CA (cluster-autoscaler) will not exceed 40 due to config. Also a couple of pods stuck in ImagePullBackOff slowing scheduling.

maya: FYI CS reports three enterprise customers seeing elevated latency/timeouts: enterprise-123, fintech-app, and retail-batch. They've filed support tickets. Maya (CS) standing by to coordinate messages.

sam: immediate mitigations: 1) divert non-critical traffic to fallback model, 2) try to free up pending pods (evict low priority), 3) request manual maxNodes bump.

priya: I'm going to patch routing to send 'free_tier' and 'background' requests to quantized-small for 10m. Command: ```bash
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \\n  https://api.redwood/prod/routes/override \\n  -d '{"selector":"tier:free","target_model":"gpt-small-q4"}'
```

priya: applying now.

diego: good. I can try to evict a few low-priority pods to free resources: ```bash
kubectl delete pod -l job=bulk-embed --namespace=ml-jobs --grace-period=0 --force
```

diego: done, freed ~6 pod slots. Scheduling still blocked because no node capacity left.

sam: pinging infra pager: @lee-infra can we get a manual cap raise for gpupool-prod to maxNodes=60? Need temporary increase for next 1h. Also confirm cloud GPU quota can be bumped to 60.

lee-infra: oncall here. I'll open a manual cap raise with cloud support and update nodepool max. ETA ~12-18 minutes for support approval. Also starting a fast path: we can add a pre-warmed node pool if quota allows.

infra-bot: Runbook step 3: manual-cap-raise -> create ticket #CLD-4823, update CA config map, monitor node join. Link: https://internal/support/CLD-4823

sam: while we wait, let's reduce batch sizes for live inference to decrease memory pressure. Priya can you push config?

priya: done, lowered batch_size from 8 -> 4 for the heavy routes. Should cut some enqueue time.

lee-infra: cloud support responded, approved quota increase to 60 GPUs for project. I'm patching nodepool max now. Command I'm using: ```bash
kubectl patch nodepool gpupool-prod -n infra --type='merge' -p '{"spec":{"maxNodes":60}}' || true
# if using autoscaler configmap
kubectl patch configmap cluster-autoscaler -n kube-system --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/maxNodes","value":"60"}]' || true
```

lee-infra: submitted and cloud is provisioning. Nodes starting to join. monitoring join events.

sam: seeing new instances registering: +5 nodes in last 2m. queue length dropping: 2124 -> 940.

diego: pods scheduling now, Pending -> Running. Confirming replicas scaled to meet queue.

maya: CS: notifying affected customers that we're mitigating and expected resolution within 20-30m. Draft message posted to #customer-updates for review.

sam: good. leaving this thread but handing off to lee-infra and diego to watch until stable. I'll remain available if pages recur.

lee-infra: will monitor for 40m. Current metrics: queue ~320, p95 latency back to baseline 180ms, GPUs util ~72%. Leaving route overrides active for 15m then revert if stable.

diego: logging actions for postmortem: CA maxNodes prevented autoscale -> manual quota bump + nodepool patch -> nodes join -> throughput restored. Need follow-up: increase buffer in CA config, add alert for CA hitting maxNodes, and investigate why ImagePullBackOffs occurred during surge.

sam: ack. I'll spin up incident page and assign follow-ups: postmortem owner diego, CS comms owner maya, infra quota automation lee-infra.

customer-success: Thanks team — CS will follow up with impacted customers and escalate refunds if required.

lee-infra: closing the on-call loop: we'll revert route overrides in 12m if stable and scale down unused pre-warmed pool after 30m. Marking incident mitigated for now; full postmortem pending. :white_check_mark:
